claims.evidence: Witness photos show two stacked electronic keyboards with control panels, but no readable brand/model text; the exact DGX 520 cannot be confirmed from the provided observations.

risks.risk: Whether the keyboard(s) actually power on and produce sound (keys, speakers, volume, display).
risks.proof: A short clip showing power-on and a few seconds of playing (keys pressed) with audible sound and the display/control screen visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst-case: treat as faulty/untested).

risks.risk: Physical condition: missing/warped keys, dead notes, damaged buttons/knobs, or screen problems.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full keybed (left-to-right) plus close-ups of every knob/button area and the display showing no cracks/lines.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible defects (worst-case: assume some controls/keys may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Accessories and power: correct adapter/charger included and compatible.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact power adapter/charger label (voltage/amp) and a clip plugging it in and powering the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/unknown power accessory (worst-case: buyer may need to source a compatible adapter).

risks.risk: Unclear which of the two keyboards is the claimed Yamaha DGX 520 (or whether both are different models).
risks.proof: Photo of the model/serial label on the back/bottom of the specific unit being sold, with the label text readable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the least certain option (worst-case: model mismatch risk).

risks.risk: Included items: stands, pedals, sustain pedal, USB/cables, and any bundled accessories.
risks.proof: Inventory photo/clip showing all included accessories laid out (especially sustain pedal) and ports/cable connections.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as minimal/no accessories included (worst-case: buyer must buy missing pedal/stand).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the back/bottom label showing brand and exact model (DGX 520) for the specific keyboard being sold.
Send a power-on video showing the display lights up and keys produce sound (volume working).
Send close-ups of the entire keybed and the control panel (knobs/buttons) to confirm no dead keys or damaged controls.
Show the exact power adapter/charger label and confirm it powers the keyboard in a short clip.
List and show all included accessories (especially sustain pedal/stand) with photos.
response.reason: The witness confirms there are two electronic keyboards, but the photos do not provide readable brand/model identification and do not confirm working condition. Without proof of the exact DGX 520 and functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
